 PLDT, Choco Mucho dispute semifinal ticket
 Mark Escarlote · 19 November 2026 · 1:45 AM PHT · 4 MIN READ 
 SAVI Davison is tipped to provide the spark when PLDT collides with Choco Mucho for a spot in the semifinals of the PVL Season 10 All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Thursday.
 PHOTOGRAPH COURTESY OF PVL
 Text size A− Reset A+ Save Games today: 
 (Mall of Asia Arena) 
 1 p.m. -- Capital1 
 Also read Choco Mucho eliminates PLDT, completes semis cast 
 vs Galeries Tower 
 6 p.m. -- PLDT vs Choco Mucho 
 It’s win-or-bust for PLDT and Choco Mucho when they meet in a virtual do-or-die for a semifinals ticket in the Premier Volleyball League (PVL) Season 10 All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series today at the Mall of Asia Arena.
 Expect an all-out war when the two teams collide in an explosive 6 p.m. main game for the right to join unbeaten Nxled and Farm Fresh to the next round.
 The race for the last two Final Four seats has narrowed down to three teams after the Chameleons defeated defending champion Creamline, 25-20, 12-25, 25-21, 25-19, last Tuesday for their seventh win.
 Also read
 VOLLEY PLDT, Farm Fresh eye crucial victory
 Games today:
 Mark Escarlote · 10 November 2026 
 In the process, the semis twice-to-beat Nxled also gave the Foxies (5-2) a free pass to the next round and a chance to vie for the other Final Four incentive.
 Left to go after each other’s throats for the remaining semis seats are the High Speed Hitters, Flying Titans and Cool Smashers, who are in a crowded logjam at third with 4-3 win-loss records.
 PLDT and Choco Mucho get first dibs on the third semis berth while Creamline takes its turn to secure a bus ride to the knockout phase against red-hot Farm Fresh on Saturday at the end of the eliminations.
 The High Speed Hitters come into the game riding the crest of their 25-13, 25-23, 23-25, 25-18, victory over Galeries Tower last Saturday.
 PLDT main gunner Savi Davison braces for another grind-out game opposite a motivated Flying Titans side, which is on a high from a 23-25, 25-13, 25-23, 22-25, 15-13, triumph over sister team Creamline to stay alive in the hunt for a semis seat.
 “I think coming off their win, they’re also motivated. We’re tied in the rankings. I think we know that they are coming in strong,” Davison said.
 “So, I think we really have to dive in on our side especially, and kind of work on the things that we need to work on, and not so much focus on their side, but how we can play to our full potential coming off this game (against Galeries Tower).”
 Backstopping the power-hitting Filipino-Canadian winger are Kim Kianna Dy, Jessa Ordiales, Majoy Baron, Dell Palomata, veteran playmaker Kim Fajardo and decorated libero Kath Arado.
 “If we’re all on the same page, if we’re all ready to compete, I feel like we can give anyone a hard time. So, it’s really up to us and hopefully we come prepared,” Davison added.
 After a slow crawl up the standings, Choco Mucho is now within a win of a playoffs appearance.
 Head coach Dante Alinsunurin and his Flying Titans have shown what they can accomplish playing on the same page.
 Hungry for a semifinal return since finishing fourth in the second AFC of the 2024-2025 season, Choco Mucho is determined to seize the opportunity to draw closer to a first-ever crown.
 “I’ve been telling the team that we can’t win with just one or two people alone. It’s important for us to show team effort in everything that we do,” Alinsunurin said.

for PVL All-Filipino title
 Games today:
 Mark Escarlote · 23 April 2026 
 Eya Laure, Sisi Rondina-Rosales, Kat Tolentino, Maddie Madayag, Caitlin Viray, Jewel Encarnacion, liberos Thang Ponce and Dawn Macandili-Catindig and setter Deanna Wong all did their part to bring down the Cool Smashers in only their second win in 21 head-to-head meetings.
 Alinsunurin expects the same effort from his squad once again.
 “Knowing PLDT, they're really gonna give us a good game. So, I think on our side, we really have to work on our strengths and to work on how we can perform better as a team,” said Madayag, who will be busy trying to contain Davison and other PLDT attackers.
 Meanwhile, also-ran teams Capital1 (2-5) and Galeries Tower (1-6) seek to end their campaign on a winning note at 1 p.m.
